cell.sampling: T 1.0 / top-p 1.0 / min-p 0, seed 3000000 + problem index (paired with every stored hard328 edit cell)

cells.command: bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && rm -rf /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.wsp_edit --recipe top8 --other rl_code --scale 1.5 --dir /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model-path /tmp/theta --model-label top8x1.5_code31 --prompt cue --set hard328 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --seed 3000000 --shard 0/2 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)
cells.readout: cap hits (finish reason length) among the 164 problems of shard 0/2, from metrics.json / answers.jsonl
cells.why: f2-m03 lets Code's directions act on math text only through the 0.22-0.26 input overlap, so at 1.5x they give about half of Math 1.5x's cap-hit cut (77 -> ~19 per 328), i.e. ~48/328 = 24 here (cued base ~38 on this half). stopping-m03 reads only the edit's energy: Code top-8 at 1x already cut cap hits as far as Math top-8 at 1x (41 vs 46), so at 1.5x it lands at Math 1.5x's ~19/328, about 10 here.

cell.sampling: T 1.0 / top-p 1.0 / min-p 0, seed 41000000 + problem index (the seeds of the stored cued-base T1 cell, 27 cap hits)

cells.command: bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && rm -rf /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.wsp_edit --recipe top8 --other rl_math --scale -1.0 --dir /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_cell --model-path /tmp/theta --model-label top8x-1_math31 --prompt cue --set math500 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --seed 41000000 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)
cells.readout: cap hits among the 500 MATH-500 answers (metrics.json cap_hits)
cells.why: f2-m01 makes the 8 directions a signed dial, so at size -1 MATH-500 cap hits rise above the cued base's 27 (hard328 went 77 -> 96, and negative size lengthens answers). stopping-m03 says stopping follows the root of the summed squared singular values an edit adds, which does not depend on sign, so -1 acts like +1 and cuts cap hits by about the same factor as +1 did on hard328 (0.6x): about 15.

cells.why: The plain theta curve (224, 405, 443, 463 at a = 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1) fits 224 + 239(1 - exp(-a/0.177)). weights-m06 has the nominal dose arrive, so a = 0.0625 gives about 295. f2-m06 thresholds sub-half-ulp entries, so effective size grows faster than nominal (0.25 -> 0.12, effective ~ a^1.53, 0.0625 -> ~0.015); refit on effective size, that gives about 262.

cells.readout: right answers of the 164 shard-0/2 problems, grader v3
cells.why: weights-m01 ties both finishing and breakdown to the size of the top direction, so top-64 at 2x behaves like top-8 at 2x and top-1 at 2x (190 and 184 of 328): about 93 of 164, over-committing but not broken. stopping-m03 uses total top-subspace energy: top-64 at 1x is 0.115 % of the weight norm against 0.074 % for top-8, so 2x is like top-8 at ~3.1x. That is past its degeneration level, like top-8 at 3x (117/328): about 58.

cells.why: weights-m02 treats a part as the whole scaled by its share. MLP-only at 1x (181) sits like the whole edit at ~0.6x, so MLP-only at 3x acts like the whole at ~1.8x, between 200.25 (1.5x) and 190 (2x) of 328: about 97 here. weights-m01 says the top direction of each matrix at 3x breaks generation whatever else is added, so this cell decays like top-1 3x (168, 67 unboxed) or top-8 3x (117): about 70.

cells.why: weights-m03 puts the finishing readout in the late MLPs, whose top directions write Wait/Okay/stop logits into the unembedding. Their top 3 at 3x then cut cap hits about as far as the full top-8 at 1x (46/328): about 23 here, against ~38 for the cued base. weights-m02 gives this part only its small share of the edit (24 of 1,792 direction terms, a few % of the norm), so at 3x it acts like the whole edit at ~0.15x: cap hits near the base, about 36.

cells.command: bash studies/rlneurons/jobs/setup_vllm.sh && rm -rf /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.delta_sum --host think_sft --donor rl --alpha 2.0 --dir /tmp/theta && /opt/rln-vllm/bin/python -m studies.rlneurons.jobs.run_fresh --model-path /tmp/theta --model-label sft_plus_2rl --prompt cue --set fresh2026 --temperature 1.0 --top-p 1.0 --seed 3000000 --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD)
cells.readout: right answers of 136, grader v3, one sample
cells.why: weights-m04: the delta only closes Think-SFT's cut work, adding right answers only where that work was sound. On hard328 cap hits fell by 0.53x and right answers rose by 0.45 per removed cap hit; 2026 cut work is less sound. So Think-SFT cue's 60.0 (45.6 % capped) gains about 8: ~68. f2-m02 keeps right-of-finished flat (fixes offset guesses), so finished share ~79 % at Think-SFT's 80 % precision gives about 86.

Scaled to the final top-8's size it moves opening and register only, so cap hits stay at the cued base's level (~38 here; random rank-8 stays flat at 67-79/328). stopping-m03 cares only about added top-subspace energy, so at final-top-8 energy it cuts cap hits like top-8 1x (46/328): about 23.
